question: Maintenance of International Peace and Security is the main purpose of which of the following Units/Organisations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UNO.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****UNO**

__
 
• The **United Nations is an intergovernmental organization **whose stated purposes are

 
 
• maintain international peace and security,
 
• develop friendly relations among nations,
 
• achieve international cooperation, and
 
• be a centre for harmonizing the actions of nations.
 
 
 
• It has **six main organs**:
 
 
• the General Assembly,
 
• the Security Council,
 
• the Economic and Social Council,
 
• the Trusteeship Council,
 
• the Secretariat are based at UN Headquarters in New York and 
 
• the International Court of Justice, is located at The Hague in the Netherlands.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The North Atlantic Treaty Organization(NATO)** is an intergovernmental military alliance between 30 member states(28 European and two North American).
 
• The **World Health Organization(WHO) **is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for **international public health.**
 
• The **World Trade Organization(WTO)** is an intergovernmental organization that **regulates and facilitates international trade.**
